inventory_snapshot.external_scan_scope: Targeted IDX/forward/Open/Financial/Foreign/Corporate/Ownership/Free-float/Market/Universe roots under the configured external project root; unrelated project roots excluded.

groups.scope: Tracked source, tests, docs, config samples, schemas, frozen identity tables, and sanitized fixtures.
groups.reason: These files define contracts, executable code, reproducibility metadata, and small test inputs; origin/main currently contains no large data/model payload.
groups.payload_policy: Keep payloads small, reviewable, deterministic, and free of credentials or user-specific absolute paths.

groups.scope: Small external summaries, coverage tables, manifest/hash files, and frozen row/session identity lists.
groups.reason: The repository needs the decision summary and byte identity, not the payload. Copy only scrubbed small metadata when a lane explicitly accepts it; otherwise reference it by external root key and SHA.
groups.payload_policy: No raw attachment, provider response, full panel, runtime log, or model binary is promoted by this registry task.

groups.scope: Full OHLCV/session/tradability/execution archives, forward monitoring runtime, and generated caches.
groups.reason: Large raw/derived market data and runtime state are expensive, mutable, and not suitable for Git; manifests and accepted summaries are sufficient for identity.
groups.payload_policy: Never copy or rewrite these files as part of repository organization.

groups.scope: Financial filing attachments, raw responses, fact/provenance JSONL, feature panels, and model-era run directories.
groups.reason: The corpus contains thousands of XLSX/ZIP attachments and large provenance/panel artifacts. Only small accepted census summaries and manifests are Git candidates.
groups.payload_policy: Do not push filing payloads, feature panels, joblib models, or protected outcomes.

groups.scope: Historical/session foreign-flow raw captures, representations, and alpha-run outputs.
groups.reason: Session raw JSON and parquet archives are large and provider-derived; preserve hash-pinned manifests and coverage summaries only.
groups.payload_policy: No model/alpha outputs or raw session archive is copied to Git.

groups.scope: Official/KSEI PDF, HTML, binary, and raw corporate-action captures.
groups.reason: Raw source bytes remain provenance evidence and should stay external; small verdict/manifests may be summarized in Git.
groups.payload_policy: Do not adjust prices or copy source attachments under this task.

groups.scope: KSEI/IDX ownership, HSC, free-float, and LBRE source/history captures.
groups.reason: The scan includes thousands of PDF/TXT/binary source captures and large monthly histories; Git should carry contracts, summaries, and hashes only.
groups.payload_policy: No source archive or derived panel is copied.

groups.scope: Market/index/breadth, PIT sector, and historical-universe source captures.
groups.reason: Small normalized calendars, membership tables, and audit summaries are reproducibility-critical; raw API/attachment captures are not.
groups.payload_policy: Promotion requires an accepted source contract and scrubbed metadata; no raw-source copy here.

groups.scope: Historical Open residuals, TradingView/Investing/Stockbit captures, and provider archives.
groups.reason: The targeted top-level scan captured the Open root separately; broader provider/runtime roots are governed by the same external-only rule even when their names are nested in runtime roots.
groups.payload_policy: No provider call, backfill, model/outcome work, or source migration is authorized.
